title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-108-26二模

items.zh: 亲爱的班长,能在我的毕业相册上签名并写一句祝福吗?
items.en: Class monitor, would you please sign my graduation album and write a few beautiful words for me?

items.zh: 原来是她的宠物猫踩到了键盘,发了这条令人摸不着头脑的消息。
items.en: It turned out that her pet cat stepped on the keyboard, sending a puzzling message.

items.zh: 市长嗅到了这一绝佳的机遇,提议新建一条连接城乡的公路。
items.en: The mayor was very alert to the golden opportunity, proposing to build a road connecting urban and rural areas.

items.zh: 这台机器人在台上闪转腾挪,上演了精彩的中国功夫,不仅赢得了连连掌声也收获了大量订单。
items.en: Moving with agility on the stage, the robot performed stunning Chinese Kung Fu, which not only won waves of applause, but also secured numerous orders.
